description: This file defines the interface Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage, which specifies methods for storage operations related to user agent information in the Zend Framework HTTP component.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage
classes.description: An interface defining methods for user agent storage management, including checking if storage is empty, reading, writing, and clearing storage contents.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Determines whether the storage is empty.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads and returns the contents from storage.
